column1: # Manipuri (Meitei) word gold set, written 2026-11-18 from the sources below before the Manipuri rules
# were run on these items. Format: word, pronunciation(s) separated by |, category, source. Categories: mtei
# = word in Meetei Mayek, beng = word in Bengali script. Sources: W = Wiktionary, Manipuri entry with a
# pronunciation (English Wiktionary, Category:Manipuri terms with IPA pronunciation, CC BY-SA 4.0, read
# 2026-11-18): the headword in Meetei Mayek and the pronunciation as the entry gives it (the first one
# when there are several spellings of it; tone marks and syllable dots kept as written); B = the same
# Wiktionary entry's pronunciation for the Bengali-script spelling of the word that Bengali-script Meitei
# text uses (the spelling as attested in the IndicGenBench Flores-IN Manipuri sentences, CC BY-SA 4.0,
# matched to the Meetei Mayek headword letter for letter: a lonsum letter is a bare consonant or one with
# hasanta, a final consonant without a vowel sign is one written with া); N = Meitei numeral as listed in
# the Wikipedia article "Meitei language" (CC BY-SA 4.0), in Meetei Mayek as listed there and in Bengali
# script as attested in the IndicGenBench sentences, pronunciation hand-written from the article's
# romanisation (a = ɐ, aa = a). Letter names and affixes are left out. The evaluation compares a broad
# transcription (tools/eval/bho_eval.py): tone marks, syllable dots and the unreleased mark are removed,
# ɐj ɐw are ei ou (the Wikipedia article "Meitei language": /ɐj/ [ej], /ɐw/ [ow]), a glide after a vowel
# is i or u, r is ɾ, a length mark after a consonant is a doubled consonant.
# Manipuri (Meitei) sentence gold set, written 2026-11-18 before the Manipuri rules were run on these items.
# Bengali script: lines of Bengali-script Meitei text (songs and prose) in AI4Bharat IndicCorp v2 Manipuri (CC0),
# which the Meetei Mayek sentence sets never contain. Meetei Mayek: the Meetei Mayek sentences of Tatoeba
# (CC BY 2.0 FR; Tatoeba has eleven Manipuri sentences, eight of them in Meetei Mayek; the seven without Latin
# letters are here) and lines of IndicCorp v2 Manipuri text in none of tools/eval/data/mni_dev.tsv,
# mni_heldout.tsv and mni_wiki.tsv. Pronunciation hand-written word by word: the words of words.src as given
# there, the others from the letter values of words.src and the morphemes of the words, which neither script
# marks: a stem that ends in a consonant keeps it closed before a suffix (Bengali মোমবি mombi, Meetei Mayek
# ꯃꯔꯨꯄꯀꯤ mɐɾupki), a suffix vowel written া or ꯥ at the end of a word is ɐ (-বা -bɐ, ꯂꯥꯎꯕꯥ laubɐ); tone is not
# Columns: id, kind, text, expected, category, source (with licence), split, date written.
